pages.title: Dark Matter
pages.text: Matter that feels gravity but ignores light. Bottled, it looks like nothing at all; the flask is merely heavier than it should be. Galaxies are wrapped in halos of this, holding them together like an invisible net.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Vera Rubin saw galaxies spinning too fast for what they showed. Sweeping the halo with the Dark Matter Halo Collector, I gathered something that registered only on my scales.
